Name: Seeds N' Saplings - SVE Forage Crops
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/PoNSvOM.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
Seeds N' Saplings add-on for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26731]SVE Forage Crops and Bushes[/url], can be used without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29387]Seeds N' Saplings[/url], but will look best with the matching seedbags and saplings.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Aj354v4.png[/img]﻿[/center]﻿
[u][b]Seasonal Seedbags and Saplings[/b][/u]
This option colour codes seedbags to their farming season, and saplings to their harvest/fruiting season. [b]Green[/b] for spring, [b]pink [/b]for summer, [b]brown[/b] for autumn and [b]blue[/b] for winter, just like the craftable wild seed bags. This is especially handy in case you happen to be forgetful like me and have many modded crops. There are two different Seasonal Options.

[u][b]Non Seasonal Seedbags and Saplings[/b][/u]
With this option, seedbags stay the same colour all year around, and has six different colour options to choose from.

[u][b]Seasonal Sapling Leaves[/b][/u]
The leaves on saplings will change with the seasons depending on the fully grown tree or bush. Disabled by default.

[u][b]Different Sapling Designs[/b][/u]
You can pick between the usual, vanilla game's sack or a garden pot for tree saplings.

[u][b]Darker Wood 'Medieval' Crop Textures[/b][/u]
On crops that come with wooden trellis, there's options for a darker wood colour, particularly to fit with [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Gweniaczek?gameId=1303]Gwen's Medieval Series[/url] or [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch?gameId=1303]Bog's[/url]﻿ [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods?gameId=1303]Witchy series[/url]

[b][u]Alternative Crop Textures[/u][/b]
Included in the mod folder, this adds another colour for Mushroom Colony's modular raised bed crop. This requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] to work and if you do not want this feature, then simply delete the [b][AT] Seeds N' Saplings - SVE Forage[/b] folder from the [b]Seeds N' Saplings - SVE Forage[/b] main folder.

[u][b]Heavily Configurable[/b][/u]
This mod, like my others, is completely configurable. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/PoStKKx.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26731]SVE Forage Crops and Bushes[/url] (Along with all the dependancies needed for it) Optionally download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] as well for extra modular features.
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.
